html:
Question 12
?

Which of the following best describes the projection of the intersection between the elliptic cone x2+2(y−1)2=6(z+3)2 and the plane x+y−4=0 onto the yz-plane?

a
An ellipse centered at (2,−3)
b
An ellipse centered at (3,−2)
c
A hyperbola centered at (2,−3)
d
A hyperbola centered at (3,−2)
e
A parabola with vertex at (2,3)
